title: Dream Catcher Cottage Seaside, FL
meta_description: Dream Catcher is in an ideal location Seaside, Florida home just six houses to the beach and one block to downtown Seaside, Florida. Walk to over 35 restaurants and shops from your front door! Sleeps 8.
description_expanded: Description53 EAST RUSKIN STREETKING, QUEEN, 2 TWINS, 2 TRUNDLE BEDSWelcome to Dream Catcher in Seaside, FloridaDream Catcher is a cheerful and welcoming beach cottage offering two bedrooms, two bathrooms, and a bonus loft, perfectly suited for families or groups looking to experience the best of Seaside, FL. Painted a sunny yellow and full of coastal charm, this home is located just six houses from the beach and one block from downtown Seaside, placing you steps from sugar-white sand, iconic architecture, and vibrant town life.Prime East Ruskin Street LocationIdeally positioned on peaceful East Ruskin Street, Dream Catcher offers both tranquility and convenience. Guests enjoy a short stroll to private beach access at the East Ruskin Pavilion and easy walking distance to Seaside’s shops, dining, and entertainment. The shaded setting and proximity to the Gulf make this cottage an excellent choice for a relaxing yet centrally located 30A vacation.Outdoor Living & Front Porch CharmArrival is effortless with convenient parking and entry through a screened-in front porch, thoughtfully furnished with lounge seating and a classic bench swing. This inviting space is perfect for morning coffee, afternoon reading, or unwinding in the evening—on especially quiet nights, you may even hear the sound of waves rolling in from the beach.Open-Concept Living & Coastal StyleInside, the first floor features an open, airy floor plan filled with natural light and relaxed coastal vibes. The comfortable living area includes a spacious sofa, tall ceilings, and a large mounted flat-screen TV—ideal for movie nights or catching the big game. The adjoining dining area seats six at a wooden table, while the fully equipped kitchen offers everything needed for meals at home, including a four-burner electric cooktop, Sub-Zero refrigerator, dishwasher, microwave, toaster, and coffee maker. Additional bar seating for two and access to the rear porch complete the space.Private Backyard RetreatStep outside to a spacious fenced backyard designed for laid-back outdoor living. Guests will love the charcoal grill, outdoor dining table for four, and two relaxing hammocks—perfect for afternoons spent enjoying the coastal breeze or evenings under the stars.Comfortable Bedrooms & Bonus LoftThe king primary bedroom, located at the front of the home, features French doors opening to the front porch, a private mounted flat-screen TV, closet, and a marble en-suite bath with a single vanity and tub/shower combination. The queen guest bedroom at the rear of the home offers a closet, mounted flat-screen TV, and easy access to a shared marble bathroom with a single vanity and glass-enclosed walk-in shower.Just off the living area, a bonus loft accessed by a ship’s ladder provides additional sleeping space with two twin beds and trundles, accommodating up to four guests—an ideal setup for kids or teens.Your Perfect Seaside EscapeWhether you’re dreaming of beach days, bike rides through town, or relaxing evenings on the porch, Dream Catcher delivers an unbeatable Seaside experience. With its prime location, inviting design, and thoughtful amenities, this charming cottage is the perfect home base for your next Seaside, Florida getaway on 30A.Must be 25 years of age to rent and sign the registration. 3-night minimum Spring, Spring Break | 5-night minimum Summer | 3-night minimum Fall | 2-night minimum WinterFEATURES1,042 square feet of thoughtfully designed living spacePrivate Seaside residential beach access at East Ruskin PavilionJust 279 feet (approximately a 1-minute walk) to beach accessCharcoal grill for outdoor cookingOutdoor dining for four plus two hammocks in the private rear yardThree large flat-screen TVs with media access in every bedroomStackable washer & dryer for guest convenienceAccess to Seaside amenities, including 3 swimming pools, 5 clay tennis courts, 3 pickleball courts (court fees apply), and a fitness centerWelcome tote with two beach towels, a complimentary bottle of wine, and two complimentary rental bikes for pickup at the Seaside Transit AuthorityPersonalized service throughout your stay with starter amenities providedTwo parking passes issued for two-bedroom homes. A golf cart is considered a car. Golf carts are prohibited for non-homeowners visiting Seaside. Special circumstances and medical needs may request a golf cart permit. No pets allowedSTR24-000356
